message.content:
Copernicus was criticized by Aristotelian astronomers, Jesuit scholars, and defenders of Ptolemy.  
Christoph Clavius rejected the heliocentric theory and defended the older system.  
Tycho Brahe rejected full heliocentrism and criticized aspects of the model.  
Did Clavius challenge the new model?  
Did Tycho Brahe deny Earth's movement?  
Did religious authorities fear the idea?  
Those critics challenged a bold new astronomy!  
What a powerful resistance to Copernicus!  
Such a dispute marked the age of science!
